create_CompressionInterceptionLogger: create a CompressionInterceptionLogger instance to compress inbound Anthropic Messages requests and fulfill retrieval tool calls server-side
build_from_config_yaml: build a CompressionInterceptionLogger from a CompressionInterceptionConfig dictionary with optional embedding model and compression parameters
initialize_from_proxy_config: initialize a CompressionInterceptionLogger from litellm proxy settings and callback-specific configuration parameters
compress_anthropic_messages: compress a list of Anthropic Messages for a model when token count exceeds the configured compression trigger threshold
run_agentic_loop_plan: run a typed agentic loop plan that rebuilds the request with retrieved tool results from the compressed content cache
